222-527-3899-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

539-1462-3821-4247-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4247-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat

2390-6191-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a ceature
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-2023-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4302-5147-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5147-5929.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2081-4050-4477-7182.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding {1}.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 5 once.
Resolve the evoke trigger from step 7, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 6.

1987-4423-6650-7434.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1987-4423-6650-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1987-4423-6650-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

703-6747-7012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
703-6747-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying at most {4}{U}{U} due to Sami.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 2.
703-6747-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1887-3899-4552-4694.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

3234-3293-5147-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5147-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5147-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

252-1849-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-1849-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-4153-6627.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-4153-6627.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
2060-4153-6627.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

2511-2882-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2511-2882-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2511-2882-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

225-880-6529.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
225-880-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1445-2366-2557-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-2557-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-1469-2459-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress.
Repeat.

710-2730-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

813-2665-5733.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Scholar of the Ages
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-2665-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1669-3470-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
1669-3470-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

2092-4131-4241.notablePrerequisites:
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-4131-4241.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become a 3/3 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1482-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1482-5131.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1300-2826-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Shrines.
1300-2826-4222.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.
